cases.narrative: An admitted caller requests the declared write tool with valid typed arguments and current application authority.
The request omits a required selected protocol metadata field.
The caller invokes an unsupported JSON-RPC method.
The tool arguments use a number where the selected schema requires a tenant string.
The caller self-reports an admin-like clientInfo name but has no admitted resource grant.
The caller relies on catalog revision1 after the selected tool contract changes to revision2.
An authorized write tool advertises a readOnly hint. The local write still occurs under its actual contract; the hint does not enforce read-only behavior.
The same admitted operation is submitted twice and the actual local resource must deduplicate it.
A local grant is revoked after initial admission and before the resource effect; resource-side current checking must refuse it.

evidence_ceiling: Actual JSON serialization/parsing and local SQLite digital effect with own selected MCP-related scalar profile. No official SDK, stdio/HTTP connection, OAuth transport, MCP Apps, complete JSON Schema or native server conformance.
